task: Measure repeated project checking before deciding whether to reuse checked state for semantic snapshot creation.
observation: Regex (49 functions) and datastructures (112 functions) each ran two checker profiles on the same single-source Application project. Reusing the checked Program for snapshot creation reduced them to one profile each; the baseline/candidate five-repetition local suite measured regex -48.7% and datastructures -46.9%.
impact: The measured duplicate pass was substantial in both elapsed time and repeated checker work on real project fixtures, justifying narrowly gated reuse while retaining broader and overridden-source reanalysis.

resolution.summary: Reuse is limited to the exact single-source Application check with no overrides; same-path snapshot bytes and all required compiler gates matched baseline behavior.
